title_zh: v129-v130：从失败的重启 K1 到双状态 Krylov 机制容量突破
title_en: v129-v130: from a failed restarted K1 to a dual-state Krylov mechanism-capacity breakthrough
scope_zh: 五条已开封 PoolFire fit 轨迹、3700 个 straight-ray 合成 BOS 单元；相机数 5/7/9/12，含观测、旋转、平移、内参与联合扰动。
scope_en: Five opened PoolFire fit trajectories and 3,700 straight-ray synthetic-BOS cells, with 5/7/9/12 cameras and observation, rotation, translation, intrinsics, and combined perturbations.

v129.interpretation_zh: 精确 K3 解对偶经 A^T 提升、可观测缩放并重启 K1，仍在五条轨迹全部失败。原因不是网络容量，而是重启时丢掉了第 4 步所需的 Krylov 共轭方向；因此 v129 禁止训练。
v129.interpretation_en: Even the exact K3 solution dual, lifted through A^T, observably rescaled, and followed by restarted K1, fails on all five trajectories. The missing information is the conjugate Krylov direction needed by step four, so v129 training is prohibited.

v130.interpretation_zh: v130 同时保留 K3 解对偶 z3 与 K3 到 K4 的共轭方向对偶 e3；两次 A^T 提升和两次 A 投影后，只用观测做二维盒约束最小二乘。精确教师下，3700/3700 单元以约 1e-15 误差复现 K4，证明两调用预算内的表示壳层是充分的。
v130.interpretation_en: v130 retains both the K3 solution dual z3 and the K3-to-K4 conjugate-direction dual e3. Two A^T lifts and two A projections are followed by an observation-only box-constrained 2D least-squares solve. With exact teachers, all 3,700 cells reproduce K4 to about 1e-15, proving that the two-call representation shell is sufficient.

current_model_gate.inputs: per-camera 16x16x2 observations, 18D reported pose tokens, and mask
